name: Flemish Bond
description: A brick wall in Flemish bond, stretchers and dark burnt headers alternating in every course so the headers line up into a diagonal diaper.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -50%; top: 0%; width: 166.667%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-mask: @var(--st); mask: @var(--st); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: @var(--hd); mask: @var(--hd); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --st: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 48.356% 0% / 37.96% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 96.712% 31.888% / 37.96% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0% 31.888% / 37.96% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 48.356% 63.776% / 37.96% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 96.712% 95.663% / 37.96% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0% 95.663% / 37.96% 21.6% no-repeat; --hd: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 95.147% 0% / 29.933% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 23.787% 31.888% / 29.933% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 95.147% 63.776% / 29.933% 21.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 23.787% 95.663% / 29.933% 21.6% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
